ai.overview: AZ Alkmaar bring the Belt Holders lineal championship to PEC Zwolle on November 29th, having successfully defended it 11 times in their current reign. The belt passes to whoever wins this Eredivisie clash, with no polls or committees involved—just the unbroken chain of results stretching back through league history.
key_matchups: AZ Alkmaar's 6-0-1 record this season against PEC Zwolle's struggling 1-5-1 form
PEC Zwolle's recent 0-7 loss to Feyenoord and 0-3 defeat at FC Groningen contrast sharply with AZ's 1-0 win over Telstar
AZ Alkmaar hold a commanding 14-3-9 edge in the all-time head-to-head series across 26 meetings
ai.betting_angles: AZ Alkmaar enter as Elo favorites with a 6-0-1 season record and victories in four of their last five, including a 5-2 win over Go Ahead Eagles and 3-2 at sc Heerenveen. PEC Zwolle have lost their last 2 games and sit at 1-5-1, though they did defeat AZ Alkmaar 3-1 in their most recent meeting on January 17th, 2026. The historical head-to-head heavily favors the visitors, who have won 14 of 26 all-time encounters.
ai.prediction_writeup: AZ Alkmaar's 6-0-1 record and momentum from winning their last 1 game should carry them past a PEC Zwolle side that has lost their last 2 games, including a 0-3 defeat at FC Groningen. While PEC Zwolle did win 3-1 when these teams last met in January 2026, the visitors' 14-3-9 all-time advantage and current form make them clear favorites. The Elo model backs AZ Alkmaar, and their 11 successful belt defenses in this reign suggest they know how to protect the lineal championship. Expect a competitive match, but AZ Alkmaar should leave with the belt still around their waist.
